svg.aria-label: What blame tracing changes, in the v3 pilot (40 seeds, simulated sentinel, not a frozen study). Faults caught: 7 of 40 without tracing, 40 of 40 with it. Healthy agents isolated per run: 1.57 to 0.07. Oversight cost as a share of worker spend: 13.8% to 8.4%, under the 10% ceiling. Median corrupt claims per run: about 860 to about 135.
